slots.title: copper-night cream macro - fingertip swatch, jar behind

Lower and behind, well out of focus, the open jar. THE PRODUCT. Keep it PALE BLUE and do not render it deep navy, white, teal or purple - this is the light jar of the pair, not the dark one. The lid metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY with a fine brushed grain - never rose-gold, copper, champagne, brass or warm-tinted, and never a chrome mirror. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. These are the ONLY words on the jar, in this order: (1) the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix', capital S then lower case, no trademark or copyright symbol anywhere; (2) 'COPPER PEPTIDE' - bold capitals, one line; (3) 'ADVANCED NIGHT REPAIR'; (4) 'PREMIUM FORMULA'; (5) a small crescent-moon glyph then 'NIGHT CREAM  |  2% GHK-CU  |  50ML'. A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block. INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words: the mark, wordmark, line 2, line 4 and line 5 are printed in BLACK ink; line 3 and the vertical rule are printed in strong royal-blue ink. Its brushed silver lid is OFF and lies beside it, upturned so its inner face shows, slightly out of focus. The jar's mouth is a wide circle and the cream inside reaches close to the rim.
